blinded.label: Blinded
blinded.description: Cannot see: attacks have disadvantage, attacks against it have advantage.

charmed.label: Charmed
charmed.description: Cannot attack the charmer; the charmer has advantage on social checks (the engine checks the condition source).

deafened.label: Deafened
deafened.description: Cannot hear; no mechanical effect in combat.

frightened.label: Frightened
frightened.description: Disadvantage on attacks while the source of fear is in line of sight (the engine checks the condition source).

grappled.label: Grappled
grappled.description: Speed 0. Under 2024 rules: disadvantage on attacks against everyone except the grappler (the grappler exception is not modelled).

incapacitated.label: Incapacitated
incapacitated.description: Cannot act or react; concentration is broken.

invisible.label: Invisible
invisible.description: Attacks have advantage, attacks against it have disadvantage.

paralyzed.label: Paralyzed
paralyzed.description: Incapacitated and cannot move; auto-fails STR/DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage, melee hits from within 5 ft are critical.

petrified.label: Petrified
petrified.description: Incapacitated, cannot move; auto-fails STR/DEX saves; resistance to all damage; immune to poison.

prone.label: Prone
prone.description: Disadvantage on its own attacks; melee attacks against it have advantage, ranged ones have disadvantage.

restrained.label: Restrained
restrained.description: Speed 0; disadvantage on attacks and DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage.

stunned.label: Stunned
stunned.description: Incapacitated, cannot move; auto-fails STR/DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage.

unconscious.label: Unconscious
unconscious.description: Incapacitated, cannot move, prone; auto-fails STR/DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage, melee hits from within 5 ft are critical.

exhaustion.label: Exhaustion
exhaustion.description: Stacks in levels 1-6; effects depend on the rules edition (2014 / 2024); level 6 is death.
